name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section VI – European Economic and Social Committee
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European Economic and Social Committee spent its 2024 budget of about 165 million euros. The Committee is an advisory body that gives opinions to the European Union on economic and social issues. Parliament notes the money was managed well, with almost all planned spending carried out. It also asks the Committee to improve in several areas: measuring the real impact of its work, fixing weaknesses in its internal controls, spending more on cybersecurity, and explaining its role more clearly to citizens.

- Parliament formally approves the Committee's 2024 spending; the Committee's leadership is affected.
- Parliament asks for better impact measurement, stronger internal controls and more cybersecurity spending.
- The Committee must report back on progress; Parliament will check again next year.
